speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. To better understand the progression of your symptoms, have you noticed any drooping of your eyelids or slurred speech recently?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of fluctuating weakness that worsens with exertion and improves with rest is very specific. Have you experienced any difficulty with chewing or swallowing, or do you feel like your voice becomes fatigued during conversation?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. REQUEST IMAGES: CT Chest to evaluate for thymoma.
